mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 5.0% over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following FEDFUNDS declines below 5.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following UNRATE > 0.3pp increases are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 and GDP growth (GDPC1) below 22500 in the prior quarter indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following HOUST < 1300 and GDPC1 < 22500 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) signals persistent price pressures that compel the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns during CPIAUCSL > 310 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, which generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following INDPRO < 100.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase above 3.8% and payrolls (PAYEMS) decline below 157000 in the prior month signals severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following UNRATE > 3.8 and PAYEMS < 157000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 consistently indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate capital expenditures and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following INDPRO declines below 102.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 700000) signals robust household consumption, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns during RSAFS > 700000 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.
